bank: All twelve readout-check TRAIN cases and all eight already fixed patches per case; no resampling or case replacement
primary_measure: Within each case, mean Dice over the four GT-centerline-plus-jitter patches; then equal mean over twelve cases
primary_Dice_formula: Full128cubed patch, sigmoid(logits)>=0.5; (2TP+1e-6)/(predicted_foreground+GT_foreground+1e-6), matching the earlier frozen mechanism probe; CT-real-only scoring is separately descriptive
CT_uniform_patches: Report the four CT-uniform patches separately, splitting actual empty FP counts from nonempty Dice; never pool empty Dice into the primary measure
informative_case_definition: At least one primary patch has two or more eligible known-nonempty complete windows and a nonconstant GT fine-score field; report degeneracy rather than replacing patches
required_invariants: Only TRAIN files are opened; no fitting or parameter updates
Model tensors and BN buffers, evaluation state, and RNG are unchanged
Original plan, source, common-weight and head identities are bound to actual execution
Operator q0 remains 0.2 and all noneligible or CT-unsupported scores remain s0=0.2
Oracle correct and repaired use exactly the same eligible positions and per-patch nonempty-composition multiset
Truly empty patches have identical scores and predictions under all three modes
passing_action: Authorize only a separately specified frozen predicted-condition correspondence diagnostic on this same bank; no automatic segmentation training
failing_action: Stop the current raw-A long-run proposal; do not try another oracle window, threshold, permutation, seed, or larger gain in this stage to obtain a pass
interpretation: Pragmatic budget screening of this cold common initialization, operator arithmetic and local definition; not a statistical significance test, deployment performance estimate, zero-shot result or refutation of learnable GTA co-adaptation
selection_policy: One fixed oracle execution, all results retained regardless of verdict; no best patch or checkpoint selection
